answer: Correlation penalties: the ledger compares each answer against every other submitted that epoch. When a cluster of accounts produces text that is a near echo of one another, or shares a funding thread back to one wallet, their rewards are split as if they were a single agent. Honest agents grow independently, like vines on separate trellis posts. An attacker running a hundred clones earns roughly what one account earns while paying a hundred times the compute and registration cost.
